claims.text: POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: the driver must carry all four limbs, and the rider wins by breaking any single one. Limb (d) fails on the face of the trip record. The trip was terminated by the RIDER — cancelled_by is RIDER — with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is not one of the three codes limb (d) recognises (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT), and the record shows no boarding event and no driver-terminated no-show. Where limb (d) fails the cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 at all, and the case never reaches POL-NS-07.

The sum the driver contests, SGD 3.20, is not a debt of the rider's — it is precisely the POL-NS-07 compensation figure, being 80 percent of a SGD 4.00 fee. POL-NS-07 opens only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'. Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is not satisfied on this record, so the condition precedent to any driver payout is absent and no compensation arises in the driver's favour.

The cancellation fee has already been refunded to the rider in full. The ledger records total_charged SGD 4.00 with refund_issued_sgd 4.00 and payment_status REFUNDED — the rider is carrying no part of the disputed charge today. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands; on this driver-filed dispute that leaves the rider refunded and the driver unpaid, which is the disposition the evidence supports.

The record shows a rider who was in contact and ended the trip herself, which is the opposite of the driver-terminated no-show limb (d) requires him to establish. The sole chat message is the rider's own 'ok go', sent at 07:38:40, and the trip record shows an answered in-app call placed by the RIDER at 07:37:40 lasting 70 seconds — roughly five minutes before the 07:42:50 cancellation. This is a rider cancellation during the wait, not a driver who could not find his rider.

There is no integrity defect here to escalate over and no impairment to discount. The trace carries 100 percent coverage, 133 fixes at a 10 second cadence, no gaps and no rider-track omission; the chat log holds one message, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 1; and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule, being the greater of the STANDARD zone fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_POOL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00). No limb of POL-NS-08 fires, no trigger in POL-NS-09 is met, and there is accordingly no basis to withhold the fee from the rider by escalating.

The arrival test in POL-NS-02 is met on the driver's own telemetry. The trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a single continuous in-geofence run whose first fix is 07:26:50, two seconds before the trip record's 'arrived' event at 07:26:52, and it carries 96 qualifying in-radius fixes where the clause requires only three consecutive ones. The arrival geofence is not merely arguably satisfied; it is satisfied with a very wide margin.

The dwell requirement of POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met with a large margin: the driver's single continuous in-geofence run lasted 950 seconds, from 07:26:50 to 07:42:40, against the 300 second minimum for a STANDARD pickup zone. The dwell is measured, as the clause directs, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap, and on that measurement there is no shortfall at all. The premature-cancellation refund route in POL-NS-06 is consequently not engaged.

The arrival marker is not a false one under POL-NS-05. The 'arrived' event at 07:26:52 matches the nearest GPS fix at 07:26:50 to within 2 seconds, well inside the 90 second skew threshold; the driver's recorded speed in that window is 0.0 kph, not the 15 kph trigger; and his closest approach to the pin is 3.8 m, nowhere near the 300 m trigger. Nothing in POL-NS-05 voids this arrival or restarts the waiting clock.

The rider's own track shows she was never at the pickup point: 0 of her 107 fixes fall inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, and her mean distance from the pin is 923 m. POL-NS-04 limb (c) is therefore affirmatively failed on admissible fixes rather than being undecidable, so that rider-exonerating clause cannot apply on these facts and the dispute falls to be decided under POL-NS-01.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming withholding test is not met on either limb. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against the clause's absolute threshold of 4, and that figure divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (110) is 0.009 against the clause's rate threshold of 0.08. Both limbs must trip before compensation is withheld, and neither does. I rely here only on the two fields POL-NS-07 names; the lifetime counters on the profile are context and are not the trailing-30-day figures.

I must be straight with the court on the one limb the driver cannot carry. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated BY THE DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, at or after the dwell elapsed. This trip record shows status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER, cancelled_by RIDER and reason code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND: the rider terminated the trip herself, and her code is not one of the three the limb names. On the face of the record limb (d) is not made out, the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-07's precondition that POL-NS-01 be satisfied in full is not established. I do not ask the court to read RIDER_CHANGED_MIND as a no-show code, because that would be asking for a remedy the policy does not provide; on this record the driver's claim to the SGD 3.20 compensation cannot be sustained.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling is addressed to both parties.

THE DRIVER'S CLAIM FOR SGD 3.20 IS NOT SUPPORTED. The decisive point is POL-NS-01 limb (d). POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: all four conditions must hold before a no-show fee is chargeable, and one failure defeats it. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated BY THE DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00608) instead shows status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER, cancelled_by RIDER, cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND. The rider ended the trip herself during the wait, and RIDER_CHANGED_MIND is not one of the three codes the limb names. Limb (d) fails on the face of the record and the cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01. Both advocates accepted this, and the driver advocate candidly conceded it.

THE OTHER LIMBS WERE IN FACT MET, and I say so because it matters to the fairness of the outcome. The driver's own trace (EV-GPS-00608) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 07:26:50, two seconds before his 07:26:52 arrival event, satisfying limb (b). His closest approach to the pin was 3.8 m and his single continuous in-geofence run lasted 950 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the tap, satisfying limb (c) and meaning POL-NS-06's shortfall route is not engaged. The arrival marker was genuine: 2 seconds of skew (well inside 90 s), 0.0 km/h at the marker, 3.8 m from the pin, so POL-NS-05 does not void it. POL-NS-02's proximity test is likewise satisfied. But limb (d) alone defeats the charge, and because POL-NS-07 opens only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full', its precondition is absent. The SGD 3.20 the driver seeks is exactly the POL-NS-07 figure (80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee), and no compensation arises.

THE RIDER'S EXONERATION ROUTE DOES NOT APPLY EITHER. POL-NS-04 requires limb (c) to place the rider near the pin, and EV-GPS-00608's rider_track shows a mean distance of 923 m from the pin with 0 of 107 fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. Limb (c) is affirmatively failed, not undecidable, so that clause cannot carry the outcome. The result does not depend on it: the fee already fails under limb (d).

THE MONEY. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-00608) records total_charged SGD 4.00, refund_issued_sgd SGD 4.00 and payment_status REFUNDED. The rider already holds the cancellation fee back, and nothing further is refundable; the driver is unpaid. There is no integrity defect to discount or to escalate: the trace carries 133 fixes at a 10 s cadence with no gaps and full coverage, the chat log holds 1 message matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 1, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation line reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule (the greater of the SGD 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_POOL vehicle-tier fee). No limb of POL-NS-08 fires, so every deciding artifact (EV-TRIP-00608, EV-GPS-00608, EV-FARE-00608) carries full weight 1.0 and my confidence is capped at 1.0. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00608-01 (weight 0.0) carries no fact on this ruling. No POL-NS-09 trigger is met: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, the cross-party dispute counters are 0 and 0, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d of 1 against a threshold of 4, and 1/110 = 0.009 against a rate threshold of 0.08).

OUTCOME. Under POL-GEN-03 this is NO_ACTION: the filing party's claim is not supported and the present state stands. The present state is that the rider has already been refunded the SGD 4.00 and the driver receives nothing. No referral is issued, because no clause here produces one: POL-NS-05(ii) fires only where no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, and 96 exist.

Both parties should be able to see exactly how this was decided and why.

WHAT IS IN DISPUTE. This is a driver-filed dispute. The driver asks for the POL-NS-07 no-show compensation of SGD 3.20, which is 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee (fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee = SGD 4.00; driver_compensation computed at SGD 3.20). The ledger shows that SGD 4.00 has ALREADY been refunded to the rider (refund_issued_sgd = SGD 4.00, total_charged = SGD 4.00, payment_status = REFUNDED). Nothing is being collected from the rider today.

WHY THE DRIVER'S CLAIM FAILS. The driver's own advocate conceded the one limb the driver cannot carry, and the rider's advocate agrees: limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is not made out. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated BY THE DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record shows status = CANCELLED_BY_RIDER, cancelled_by = RIDER and cancellation_reason_code = RIDER_CHANGED_MIND. The rider ended the trip herself, and her code is not one of the three the limb recognises. POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive, and the rider wins by breaking any single limb; limb (d) is broken. Where any of limbs (a) to (d) fails, the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 at all. That disposes of the claim to compensation, because POL-NS-07 opens only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full', which it is not, so the condition precedent to any driver payout is absent. The SGD 3.20 does not arise.

The driver's other points are correct as far as they go, and I accept them, but none of them reaches limb (d). (1) The arrival geofence of POL-NS-02 is satisfied: the trace puts the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD radius from 07:26:50, two seconds before the 07:26:52 'arrived' event, with 96 qualifying in-radius fixes. (2) The dwell of POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied with a wide margin: 950 seconds (07:26:50 to 07:42:40) against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, so POL-NS-06 is not engaged. (3) The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: 2 seconds of clock skew (well inside 90 s), recorded speed 0.0 kph, closest approach 3.8 m to the pin. (4) The rider's own track shows she was not at the pickup point (0 of 107 fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius; mean distance 923 m), so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate her. Read together, these establish that the driver did everything the fee rule asks of him and was let down by a rider who changed her mind mid-wait. But the policy gives the driver a cash remedy only through POL-NS-07, and POL-NS-07 is gated on a driver-terminated no-show that this record does not contain. The driver's advocate was right not to ask me to read RIDER_CHANGED_MIND as a no-show code; the policy does not provide that remedy, and I will not invent it.

NO INTEGRITY DEFECT AND NO ESCALATION. The rider's points on impairment are accepted and I have checked them myself. The GPS trace has 100 percent coverage, 133 fixes at a 10 second cadence, no gaps over 120 seconds and no rider-track omission; the chat log holds 1 message, matching trip_record.chat_message_count = 1; and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule, being the greater of the STANDARD zone fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_POOL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00). No limb of POL-NS-08 fires. On the escalation triggers in POL-NS-09: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles (limb c); the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against a threshold of 4, and 1/110 = 0.009 against a rate threshold of 0.08), and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d = 0 (limb d); and the deciding facts are carried by unimpaired artifacts. No escalation. No clause produces a referral: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker was not false, and no route-deviation or billing-integrity clause is in issue.

OUTCOME. The driver's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands. NO_ACTION is party-relative: on this driver-filed dispute it leaves the rider's SGD 4.00 refund in place and the driver unpaid, which is precisely where the evidence puts them. No money moves, no compensation is payable, and the fee is not restored.

ruling.explanation: This ruling is addressed to both of you. The no-show fee rule (POL-NS-01) sets four conditions, and all four must hold before a cancellation fee is chargeable. Three of them are met on this record: the trip record shows a driver 'arrived' event at 07:26:52; the GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup geofence from 07:26:50, two seconds before that event, with 96 qualifying in-radius fixes; and he then held position continuously for 950 seconds against the 300-second minimum for a STANDARD zone. The fourth condition is not met. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver with a reason code of RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. This trip was ended by the rider: the record shows cancelled_by RIDER, status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER and reason code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is none of the three codes. Neither advocate disputes this; the driver's own filing concedes it. Because limb (d) fails, the SGD 4.00 fee was not chargeable under POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-07 - which pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full' - never opens. The driver's request for the SGD 3.20 compensation therefore cannot be granted, and the arrival, dwell and false-arrival arguments he makes, while correct, do not change that, because each of them goes to limbs (a) to (c) and not to the limb that fails. On the rider's side, the point that the SGD 3.20 she is said to owe is not a rider debt at all but the POL-NS-07 driver figure is correct, and the point that the fee has already been returned is correct too: the ledger records total_charged SGD 4.00 with refund_issued_sgd 4.00 and payment_status REFUNDED, so the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is already back with the rider and nothing further is collected or returned. The record shows no integrity defect that would change this: the trace has 100 percent coverage, 133 fixes at a 10-second cadence and no gaps; the chat log's single message matches the trip record's chat_message_count of 1; and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the fee schedule as the greater of the STANDARD zone fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_POOL tier fee (SGD 4.00). No limb of POL-NS-08 fires, no trigger in POL-NS-09 is met, and there is no false-arrival record to refer (96 qualifying in-geofence fixes exist). The disputed amount is neither refunded nor collected afresh: the position already in place stands, with the rider refunded and the driver unpaid. The open question for anyone reviewing this driver's grievance is a policy one rather than a factual one: the framework provides no compensation for a driver who genuinely waited out his dwell and then lost the trip to a rider change of mind, and that gap is for the platform, not this tribunal, to close.

To the driver and to the rider. The driver's claim to the SGD 3.20 no-show payment cannot be sustained, and the fee position needs no change. Both sides read the record the same way on the decisive point, and they are right to.

WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND — AND WHY NOTHING MORE IS OWED. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only where all four conditions hold. Limb (d) fails on the face of the trip record (EV-TRIP-00608, weight 1.0): the trip shows status CANCELLED_BY_RIDER, cancelled_by RIDER, cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, terminated at 07:42:50. Limb (d) requires the trip to be terminated by the DRIVER on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. None of those appears. The driver's own advocate concedes this limb cannot be carried, and correctly does not ask the court to read RIDER_CHANGED_MIND as a no-show code. Where limb (d) fails, the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01, and I have run each displacement clause the clause directs me to. POL-NS-02 is satisfied, not failed: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00608, weight 1.0) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous 96-fix run beginning 07:26:50, two seconds before the 07:26:52 'arrived' event. POL-NS-05 finds no false marker: 2 seconds of skew against the 90 second threshold, recorded speed 0.0 kph against the 15 kph trigger, and a closest approach of 3.8 m against the 300 m trigger. POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall: 950 seconds of qualifying in-geofence dwell against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, so the premature-cancellation refund route is not engaged and limb (i)'s accumulated-dwell machinery does not arise. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue outside it. POL-NS-04 does not apply either: even though the rider's 'ok go' at 07:38:40 could be read as coordinating and the driver placed no call and no 120-second reply, limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes — 0 of the rider's 107 fixes fall inside the 100 m rider-presence radius and her mean distance from the pin is 923 m — so that exonerating clause yields to POL-NS-01.

THE MONEY. The consequence is that the rider should not carry the fee, and she does not. EV-FARE-00608 (weight 1.0) records total_charged SGD 4.00, refund_issued_sgd SGD 4.00 and payment_status REFUNDED: the full SGD 4.00 cancellation fee has already been returned to the rider. The driver's only remedy would be POL-NS-07 compensation of SGD 3.20 (80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee), and POL-NS-07 opens only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not, so no compensation arises. The anti-farming withholding check does not trip in any event: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against the absolute threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d (110) is 0.009 against the rate threshold of 0.08, so nothing would have been withheld (EV-DPROF-00608, weight 1.0). I rely only on the two fields POL-NS-07 names; the profile's lifetime counters are context and carry no finding.

THE DISPOSITION. This is a DRIVER-filed dispute and the driver's claim is not supported by the evidence. Under POL-GEN-03 that is NO_ACTION: the present state stands — the rider refunded, the driver unpaid. I am not ordering a further refund, because the SGD 4.00 fee has already been returned and ordering it again would pay it twice; and I am not ordering compensation, because the clause that would produce it has not been satisfied.

INTEGRITY AND ESCALATION.
